note: ACV1 conformance corpus. Every vector carries its preimage so the JavaScript and Solidity implementations each compute the result independently; neither reads the other's answer. Regenerate with fixtures/acv1/build.mjs.

vectors.name: maximal
vectors.note: every count and length at its ceiling; 332 bytes, the interpreted maximum

vectors.name: minimal
vectors.note: the smallest VALID document: 21 bytes, not the 19 of the header early-out

vectors.name: fragmentation-trait
vectors.note: FRAGMENTATION as a trait source is legal

vectors.name: strata-with-appendix
vectors.note: identical interpreted document to `strata`, different artConfigHash — the appendix is committed but never read

vectors.name: empty-appendix-is-not-an-appendix
vectors.note: a zero-length appendix must hash exactly like no appendix

vectors.name: err-flags
vectors.note: a bit outside ANIMATE is set

vectors.name: err-too-short-zero-layers-small-palette
vectors.note: ZERO LAYERS with a 1-colour palette: 15 bytes, refused by the length gate before the layer rule is ever reached

vectors.name: err-layer-count-zero-layers-large-palette
vectors.note: THE SAME DEFECT with an 8-colour palette: 36 bytes, so it reaches the layer rule and reports it. One defect, two codes, decided by an unrelated field.

vectors.name: err-layer-sensor-fragmentation
vectors.note: THE FRAGMENTATION REFUSAL: a dust swarm may not walk the artwork

vectors.name: err-layer-palette
vectors.note: a layer's palette index outside the palette

vectors.name: err-element-budget
vectors.note: 97 worst-case elements, one over the whole-artwork budget

vectors.name: err-trait-name-quote
vectors.note: a trait name carrying a quote — the character that could forge a metadata field

vectors.name: err-trait-name-backslash
vectors.note: a trait name carrying a backslash

vectors.name: err-trait-name-control
vectors.note: a trait name carrying a control character

vectors.name: raw-magic
vectors.note: the right length, the wrong magic

vectors.name: raw-19-bytes
vectors.note: EXACTLY the header early-out threshold. It clears `n < 19` and is still refused — proof that 19 is not the minimum valid length.

vectors.name: raw-20-bytes
vectors.note: one byte more, still refused. The minimum is 21.

vectors.name: raw-21-bytes-valid
vectors.note: the smallest document that is actually valid
